description: This file implements functions for handling Bluetooth Audio Broadcast (BAP) Base data, including parsing, validation, and extraction of subgroup and BIS information.

methods.name: base_pull_pd
methods.description: Pulls a 24-bit little-endian protocol delay value from the buffer.

methods.name: base_pull_bis_count
methods.description: Pulls the BIS count from the buffer.

methods.name: base_pull_codec_id
methods.description: Extracts the codec ID from the buffer into a bt_bap_base_codec_id structure.

methods.name: base_pull_ltv
methods.description: Pulls a length-value pair from the buffer, returning the length and optionally the data.

methods.name: check_pull_ltv
methods.description: Checks if a length-value pair can be successfully pulled from the buffer.

methods.name: bt_bap_base_get_base_from_ad
methods.description: Parses advertisement data to extract the Bluetooth Audio Broadcast base structure if valid.

methods.name: bt_bap_base_get_pres_delay
methods.description: Returns the presentation delay from the base structure.

methods.name: bt_bap_base_get_subgroup_count
methods.description: Returns the number of subgroups in the base structure.

methods.name: bt_bap_base_foreach_subgroup
methods.description: Iterates over each subgroup, calling a user-provided function.

methods.name: bt_bap_base_get_subgroup_codec_id
methods.description: Retrieves the codec ID from a subgroup.

methods.name: bt_bap_base_get_subgroup_codec_data
methods.description: Retrieves the codec data from a subgroup.

methods.name: bt_bap_base_get_subgroup_codec_meta
methods.description: Retrieves the codec metadata from a subgroup.

methods.name: bt_bap_base_subgroup_codec_to_codec_cfg
methods.description: Converts subgroup codec info to a codec configuration structure.

methods.name: bt_bap_base_get_subgroup_bis_count
methods.description: Returns the BIS count for a subgroup.

methods.name: bt_bap_base_subgroup_foreach_bis
methods.description: Iterates over each BIS in a subgroup, calling a user function.

methods.name: bt_bap_base_subgroup_bis_codec_to_codec_cfg
methods.description: Converts BIS codec info to a codec configuration structure.

methods.name: bt_bap_base_get_bis_indexes
methods.description: Retrieves all BIS indexes from the base structure.
